title: Museum Skip-Line QR
scenario: A QR outside a museum sells skip-line tickets at a discount.

answers.A: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.B: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.C: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.
answers.D: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.

explanation: Museum Skip-Line QR: the trap is to move you from a trusted channel to a fake page. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Buy from museum or verified ticket partners.
